title: Large-universe filtered-colimit continuity of etale cohomology
statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme X and a filtered category A in Type(u+1), the cocone obtained by applying the derived etale cohomology functor in degree q to a colimit cocone of abelian etale sheaves is a colimit cocone.

source.place: Tags 03Q5 and 0739, with the indexing universe tracked explicitly

proof.text: Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.IsFiltered.exists_directed to A. It supplies a nonempty directed partial order B in the same universe Type(u+1), and a final functor F : B → A. Install these supplied instances. No universe shrinking, torsion assumption or restriction of diagrams is needed.

The inverse of Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv F c makes c.whisker F a colimit cocone for F composed with D, with the original vertex and restricted legs. Apply the existing coefficient-size etaleCohomology_isColimit_of_isDirected X to this cocone in degree q.

Functor.mapCocone commutes definitionally with cocone whiskering in this situation, so the result of step 2 is a colimit witness for the whiskering by F of the displayed image cocone. The forward direction of Functor.Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv F applied to this image cocone gives precisely the desired witness. This elementary universal-property transport keeps both the vertex and all original mapped cocone legs.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0032, directed final reindexing, combined with the existing coefficient-size directed cohomology theorem (Tag 03Q5 and sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0739). D2 repair uses Mathlib exists_directed and Final.isColimitWhiskerEquiv to restrict and recover the supplied cocone.

theorem etaleCohomology_isColimit_large_filtered
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory A] [IsFiltered A]
    {D : A ⥤ Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}}
    {c : Cocone D} (hc : IsColimit c) (q : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) 0 ⋙
        Etale.cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X (q : ℤ)).mapCocone c))
